rules: This file is written before any P0-1..P0-4 training or evaluation; the grid below may not be extended after results are seen.
Rule-based detectors are frozen; only the name model path is varied.
No numeric improvement targets are set. Per-source targets are decided only after the frozen baseline (benchmarks/results/name-p0-baseline-e5.json) exists and are not part of this file.
Items marked assumption=true are not resolved by the plan; each must be resolved and appended as a dated amendment file BEFORE the first run that depends on it, never after seeing that run's results.
Results are reported as 'development-data candidate' only. No candidate is reported as having passed an independent evaluation while no independent heldout exists.

validation_for_checkpoint_selection.selection_rule: equal-weight per-source exact F1, reusing the multisource-v2 selection method (scripts/name_multisource_selection.py)
validation_for_checkpoint_selection.unresolved: exact weighting/tie-break must be copied from multisource-v2 source and pinned in an amendment

common.development_sets_note: All already opened (labels consumed); repeated use allowed for policy/cutoff/seed comparison. Exact IDs/hashes are in the ledger.
common.independent_final_judgement: None available. Reserve KLUE 2,000 / KDPII 2,391 are auxiliary confirmation only, opened at most once, only for a finished candidate, after a fresh exact/normalized text-overlap audit, and are never reported as independent generalization (assumption: this usage is itself an assumption in the plan).
metrics: per source and per gold policy: exact TP/FP/FN/F1
full-name coverage count under actual mask(style='stars')
three per-span regressions: lost previously exact spans, new false-positive spans, newly exposed previously fully masked names
paired sentence bootstrap, 500 repetitions, 95% interval (sentence unit, not document unit: uncertainty may be understated)
worst case by name type and by document length
CPU latency and memory (benchmarks/performance_benchmark.py reuse; suitability for name candidates is an assumption to verify)
common.kdpii_policies: PS_NAME and PS_NAME+PS_NICKNAME reported separately from the same predictions; never merged.

per_source_regression_constraints.applies_to: every experiment, development stage and final stage alike
each_source_must_satisfy_all: baseline-exact spans lost = 0 and new false-positive spans = 0 (span-level comparison)
no baseline fully-masked name becomes newly exposed under stars masking
per_source_regression_constraints.all_changes_disabled_equivalence_control: never counts as an improvement candidate
per_source_regression_constraints.no_offsetting: average improvement never offsets an individual regression

adoption_gate.a: all development sources pass the per-source constraints
adoption_gate.b: all three seeds pass (assumption: because a joint-span v1 seed failed with a single new false positive, the best seed is never cherry-picked)
adoption_gate.c: at least one source shows genuine improvement in the metric named by the hypothesis (miss, false positive or boundary error) versus the baseline
adoption_gate.d: after selection is finalized, a NEW independent heldout is opened once and passes the same constraints

stop_rules: If zero policies pass on development data: record no_candidate; do not open any heldout/reserve.
The comparison grid of policies, cutoffs and training settings is fixed in this file before running; nothing is added after seeing results.
No word/particle exceptions, name dictionaries, or per-sentence exceptions are added from development results.
Inference runs sequentially at low priority and limited CPU (nice -n 15 taskset -c ...), never in parallel; single RTX 3090 / 4 cores / 11GB RAM WSL.
common.heldout_opening_rule: candidate, checkpoint, cutoff and decoder finalized with finalized=true and file hashes recorded; opened exactly once; any change of code/weights/source during the run voids the result; a failed result used for fixes converts that whole set to development.

P0-1.title: joint character-span scoring + global span selection (A2)
P0-1.hypothesis: Per-character argmax produces no candidate for many misses; scoring start/end/inside/context jointly and choosing a maximum non-overlapping total via dynamic programming reduces candidate misses and boundary errors. Key question: does the structure that failed when trained on synthetic-only data still fail on multi-source real-sentence/dialogue training.
P0-1.changed_factor: span head and selection method only; encoder frozen (name_span_experiment.py structure kept)
controls: (i) character BIOES head trained on the same multi-source data (multisource-v2 head, weight 1)
(ii) same span head with the existing merge instead of global selection

max_span_length_L.rule: set from the training data; over-length gold spans are not dropped but counted as failures; the previous implementation used 32 characters

measurements: candidate upper-bound decomposition: exact candidate exists / after threshold / after merge, extended to real-sentence development sets (benchmarks/name_context_stage_diagnostic.py is synthetic single-window only and must be extended)
long-document window merge truncation/duplicate/omission reproduction tests (tests/test_name_span_adapter.py extension)
span computation time/memory vs sentence length (quadratic)
P0-1.extra_adoption_condition: baseline misses or full-name mask failures must decrease; reducing only false positives with unchanged misses (selection-filter case) = no gain
P0-1.stop_rule: If on all 3 seeds at least one development source violates a constraint or no improvement metric exists: record no_candidate, end this structure, no further span-scorer tuning. If multi-source training also shows no external gain over synthetic-only, hand the 'representation (encoder), not structure' hypothesis to P0-4.

P0-2.title: legal BIOES transition constraint (A1) - controlled ablation
P0-2.hypothesis: Illegal I/E-start paths cause part of boundary errors; legal-path constraint or forward-backward span probability reduces them. Recorded prior observation (not an assumption): evidence is weak and constraints are unlikely to fix candidate omission.
P0-2.changed_factor: decoder only, same head, same cache, same cutoffs; no retraining

arms.D3: D1 + global non-overlapping selection (requires P0-1 head output; run after P0-1)

P0-2.data: validation cache first (not the 96 synthetic sentences alone), then cache replay on all development sets
measurements: boundary error types: end-character truncation, particle-included over-long span, adjacent-word merge
P0-2.extra_adoption_condition: D0 and D1 identical on every source = no gain
P0-2.stop_rule: End if D1-D3 do not reduce boundary errors on development data, or any source shows a newly exposed name or new false positive. A null single-factor effect is documented as an attribution result.

P0-3.title: contextual contrastive training (A5)
P0-3.hypothesis: Name-spelling regularity bias and missing boundary negatives cause errors on unfamiliar names/contexts; hard boundary negatives, same-spelling person/non-person pairs and name-substitution invariance reduce boundary errors and spelling-dependent false positives. Effect in Korean is unverified in the literature.
P0-3.status: no implementation exists; contrast loss must be newly written
P0-3.changed_factor: include vs exclude contrast data and loss on top of the structure chosen in P0-1 (or the multisource-v2 character head if P0-1 = no_candidate); same seeds and budget

data.boundary_negatives: mechanically generated from gold spans of real train sentences (KLUE train, KDPII train) with a variation-rule set (particle-included, first/last character truncation, neighbor-word merge) written in code and fixed before results; no rules added afterwards
data.name_substitution: only inside the training split's name-spelling set; name-spelling separation kept; no evaluation-set name used

homograph_person_nonperson_pairs.sources: synthetic v4 contrast data (benchmarks/name_context_v4_cases.py, tests/test_name_context_v4_contrasts.py) inside the training split only, plus KLUE train surfaces appearing as both PS and non-PS
homograph_person_nonperson_pairs.unresolved: whether enough such KLUE train sentences exist is unknown until checked; ambiguous sentences never get invented gold

data.split_rule: variants of the same template/document never cross splits

measurements: name-substitution invariance (same relative span kept when only the name changes) - auxiliary diagnostic, not an adoption metric
P0-3.extra_adoption_condition: versus the contrast-excluded control, the hypothesis metric (boundary error or spelling-dependent false positive) must improve; if inclusion loses any existing name in any source the arm is rejected (v4 precedent: 12 non-person fixed, 8 existing names lost)
P0-3.stop_rule: End if include-vs-exclude shows no development improvement or causes a regression. Do not turn into iterative retraining on failed sentences.

P0-4.title: encoder adaptation ablation (A4)
P0-4.hypothesis: Frozen E5 representation is insufficient for Korean name boundaries/unfamiliar context. Prior LoRA (generalization v1) was trained on KLUE+synthetic only, so LoRA effect and training-data composition were confounded. LoRA trained on multi-source data has no recorded attempt (assumption: absent from docs).

arms.E1: LoRA on query/value of the last 4 layers, rank 8 (recorded earlier setting)

E2.definition: one-step wider adaptation (e.g. more layers or higher rank)

P0-4.held_equal: data, budget, seeds, decoder; the best decoder from P0-1/P0-2 is fixed first; adapted path used only for the name decision, original E5 probabilities and addresses keep the original model
P0-4.data: common training/validation, with sufficient name-free dialogue sentences (KDPII train: 378 name-positive sentences vs mostly no-name sentences must be kept)
measurements: CPU/CUDA precision differences via scripts/check_name_adaptation_device_parity.py (adapted path CUDA BF16 vs original prior FP32; precedent 11/100 sentences score differences)
training time and latency reported separately
P0-4.extra_adoption_condition: E1/E2 must beat E0 on development data and KDPII non-person false-positive sentences must be <= baseline
P0-4.stop_rule: Stop adaptation if no gain over E0 or KDPII-type false positives increase; then proceed to A6 (external Korean/multilingual PII model comparison, after checking Korean training, license and offline cost).

milestone_order.content: consumption ledger, E5 baseline re-measurement, this preregistration; start new heldout/calibration source selection in parallel
freeze common multi-source training data and feature-cache hashes, duplicate audit
P0-1 span scoring + global selection, 3 seeds
best combination 3-seed recheck, calibration cutoff fixed, selection manifest finalized
open the new independent heldout once + regression gate, CPU latency/memory
if all P0 are no_candidate, A6 external model comparison

post_p0: Best surviving combination re-trained with 3 seeds; cutoff/calibration only on a separate calibration split; until one exists only the pre-fixed grid is compared on development data and this is stated in the report. Abstention is never counted as correct or as masking success.
unresolved_assumptions: numeric improvement targets per source (to be decided only after baseline; none set here)
size and source of new independent heldout and calibration sets
3-seed-all-pass rule (plan marks it as an assumption)
pre-registration file format (this file's shape is itself the proposal)
suitability of benchmarks/performance_benchmark.py for name-candidate latency
checkpoint-selection weighting details (reuse of multisource-v2 rule)
usage of the unopened reserve as auxiliary confirmation only

identity of the 'synthetic regression data' source for per-source constraints: this file proposes synthetic v11 evaluation 192 (diagnostic) plus the retained regression tests; the plan does not pin it
data_status_labels_in_results: Every result JSON must record the status (train/validation/development/final) of each dataset it uses (plan 3.4, itself an assumption).

allowed_change_scope.global: Only the name model path (head, decoder/selection, training data composition, encoder adaptation) as defined per experiment. Rule-based detectors, address path, guard thresholds, masking and normalization code under src/ are frozen.
allowed_change_scope.P0-1: span head + selection method; encoder frozen
allowed_change_scope.P0-2: decoder only; no retraining, same head/cache/cutoffs
allowed_change_scope.P0-3: contrast data and contrast loss only, on the P0-1-selected structure (or multisource-v2 character head)
allowed_change_scope.P0-4: encoder adaptation scope E0/E1/(E2) only, decoder fixed to the best of P0-1/P0-2

development_data_used: Exactly the six development sets in common.development_comparison_sets; IDs and text hashes in the ledger. K-PII-Bench is NOT a name development set (names are outside its default profile); if ever used for numeric cross-checks it must be tied to revision 844f92f7beba98fa964f957ba324017e82451701 and file hashes, never to newer data.

adopt_reject_criteria_summary.rejected: any per-source constraint violated on any seed, or no improvement metric, or equivalence-only change

reserve_opening_policy.state_at_M0: preserved: source files were accessed to enumerate IDs (KDPII test.json fully parsed in memory); no reserve text, label or score was displayed, scored, selected or used for any decision
reserve_opening_policy.earliest_opening: only after M7 (candidate/checkpoint/cutoff/decoder finalized with finalized=true and hashes) and only if every development gate (a)-(c) passed on all three seeds; a fresh exact+normalized text-overlap audit against all train/validation/development text must precede it; opened at most once; reported as auxiliary confirmation, not independent generalization; the new independent heldout (M8) is the only basis for an adoption claim
reserve_opening_policy.never_opened_if: stop rule no_candidate is reached or origin of any baseline discrepancy is unexplained

discrepancy_policy: If a re-measured baseline differs from a documented number: do not change settings to match. Same conditions -> record as reproduction problem; different conditions -> explain the condition difference. If the cause stays unclear, do not open reserve data; audit the procedure on currently available data.
